video.title: AI欧腐《狼王的秘密继承人/The Lycan King's Secret Heir His Fated Omega》
video.desc:
Five years ago, Lycan King Arthur marked Felix but mistook a thief for his fated mate. Felix raised their son Leo alone in the slums. When they reunite, Felix's scent and Leo's royal bloodline trait draw Arthur closer. His true mate and heir are within reach, but a stolen token keeps the truth hidden.
五年前，狼王 Arthur 标记了 Felix，却把一个小偷误认成了自己的命定伴侣。Felix 独自在贫民窟里将两人的儿子 Leo 抚养长大。
重逢之时，Felix 身上的气味与 Leo 身上的王族血脉特征，让 Arthur 不由自主地靠近。他的真命伴侣与继承人就近在眼前，可一枚被偷走的信物，却让真相始终被掩盖。
